theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 27 群

items.pos: n. 專家 | adj. 熟練的
items.colloc: expert advice 專家建議 | industry expert 產業專家
items.distinct: specialist 專科醫生/專業人員 | professional 職業人士
ex: Consult an expert for financial planning.
諮詢專家進行財務規劃。
She provides expert guidance on marketing.
她提供市場行銷方面的專家指導。
Technical support experts are available now.
技術支援專家現在即可提供服務。

items.colloc: extend a deadline 延長期限 | extend an invitation 發出邀請
items.distinct: expand 擴大規模/擴張 | prolong 拉長（時間）
ex: We decided to extend the project deadline.
我們決定延長專案的截止日期。
Management will extend the office hours.
管理層將延長辦公時間。
Can you extend your stay in Taipei?
你能延長你在台北的停留時間嗎？

items.colloc: ask for an extension 要求延期 | dial an extension 撥打分機
items.distinct: extent 程度/範圍 | expansion 擴張/膨脹
ex: Please request an extension via email.
請透過電子郵件請求延期。
My office extension number is 302.
我的辦公室分機號碼是 302。
The contract extension requires further approval.
合約展期需要進一步的批准。

items.pos: v. 下跌；墜落 | n. 下降；秋天
items.colloc: fall behind 落後 | fall into a category 屬於某類別
items.distinct: decline 下滑/減少 | drop 落下/急遽下跌
ex: Stock prices might fall this afternoon.
股價今天下午可能會下跌。
Sales figures fall short of expectations.
銷售數據未達到預期。
Profits fall during the slow season.
淡季期間利潤會下降。

items.pos: n. 家庭；家族 | adj. 家庭的
items.colloc: family business 家族企業 | family responsibilities 家庭責任
items.distinct: household 一家人/住戶 | relatives 親戚
ex: He manages a successful family business.
他經營一家成功的家族企業。
Balancing family life is very important.
平衡家庭生活非常重要。
Our company supports employees' family needs.
我們公司支持員工的家庭需求。

items.pos: n. 數字；人物；圖表 | v. 計算
items.colloc: sales figure 銷售數據 | key figure 關鍵人物
items.distinct: digit 數字（0-9） | number 號碼/總數
ex: Check the latest sales figures carefully.
請仔細檢查最新的銷售數據。
She is a leading figure in tech.
她是科技領域的領軍人物。
I need to figure out the costs.
我需要計算出這些成本。

items.colloc: fill out a form 填寫表格 | fill a position 填補職位
items.distinct: fulfill 履行/實現 | complete 完成
ex: Please fill out the application form.
請填寫這份申請表格。
We need to fill this vacant position.
我們需要填補這個職缺。
The order will fill our inventory.
這筆訂單將會補滿我們的庫存。

items.pos: n. 力量；武力 | v. 強迫
items.colloc: work force 勞動力 | force someone to do 強迫某人做
items.distinct: power 權力/能源 | strength 體力/實力
ex: The company increased its work force.
公司增加了勞動力規模。
Market trends force us to innovate.
市場趨勢迫使我們進行創新。
Do not force a decision too quickly.
不要太快強迫做出決定。

items.pos: adj. 頻繁的 | v. 常去
items.colloc: frequent traveler 常旅客 | frequent updates 頻繁更新
items.distinct: common 常見的 | regular 定期的
ex: We provide frequent updates to clients.
我們提供頻繁的更新給客戶。
Frequent meetings improve team communication.
頻繁的會議改善了團隊溝通。
These shops are frequented by tourists.
這些商店是遊客常去的地方。

items.colloc: grow rapidly 快速成長 | grow into a leader 成長為領導者
items.distinct: increase 增加 | develop 發展
ex: Our company continues to grow globally.
我們公司持續在全球成長。
They want to grow their online business.
他們想要擴大其線上業務。
Sales will grow in the next quarter.
銷售額將在下一季成長。

items.pos: adj. 更高的（high 的比較級）
items.colloc: higher education 高等教育 | higher quality 更高品質
items.distinct: tall 更高的（垂直高度） | upper 上方的
ex: We aim for higher standards of service.
我們追求更高標準的服務。
Prices are higher than last year.
價格比去年更高。
He was promoted to a higher position.
他被晉升到更高的職位。

items.colloc: serious implication 嚴重後果 | legal implication 法律含義
items.distinct: influence 影響力 | consequence 後果
ex: Consider the implications of this decision.
考慮這個決定的潛在影響。
The policy has significant economic implications.
這項政策有重大的經濟影響。
They ignored the legal implications involved.
他們忽略了涉及的法律含義。

items.colloc: show improvement 顯示進步 | room for improvement 改進空間
items.distinct: advancement 前進/晉升 | progress 進展
ex: We need continuous improvement in quality.
我們需要在品質上持續改進。
There is much room for improvement here.
這裡還有很大的改善空間。
She showed great improvement this year.
她今年的表現有很大的進步。

items.colloc: increasingly popular 日益受歡迎 | increasingly difficult 越來越困難
items.distinct: gradually 逐漸地 | steadily 穩定地
ex: Digital marketing is increasingly important today.
數位行銷在今日日益重要。
It is becoming increasingly difficult to compete.
競爭變得越來越困難。
Clients are increasingly demanding high quality.
客戶日益要求高品質。

items.colloc: initially planned 最初計畫 | initially intended 最初打算
items.distinct: originally 原本 | firstly 第一地
ex: The project was initially planned differently.
這個專案最初的計畫與現在不同。
He was initially hesitant about the deal.
他最初對這筆交易感到猶豫。
We initially expected higher sales results.
我們最初預期會有更高的銷售成績。

items.colloc: insert a card 插入卡片 | insert an image 插入圖片
items.distinct: include 包含 | input 輸入
ex: Please insert your card into the reader.
請將您的卡片插入讀卡機。
You can insert a chart in reports.
你可以在報告中插入圖表。
Don't forget to insert the signature here.
別忘了在這裡插入簽名。

items.pos: adv. 主要地；很大程度上
items.colloc: largely due to 主要因為 | largely successful 大致成功
items.distinct: mainly 主要地 | mostly 大部分
ex: Success is largely due to hard work.
成功很大程度上歸功於努力工作。
The market is largely dominated by them.
該市場主要由他們所主導。
Our meeting was largely successful today.
我們今天的會議大致上很成功。

items.pos: v. 領導；導致 | n. 領先地位
items.colloc: lead a team 領導團隊 | lead to success 導致成功
items.distinct: guide 引導 | manage 管理
ex: She will lead the new marketing team.
她將會領導新的行銷團隊。
These changes will lead to efficiency.
這些改變將會導致效率提升。
The company maintains a strong market lead.
這家公司保持著強大的市場領先地位。

items.colloc: leading company 領先公司 | leading role 領導角色
items.distinct: major 主要的 | top 頂尖的
ex: They are a leading firm in technology.
他們是科技領域的領先公司。
He plays a leading role in management.
他在管理階層中扮演領導角色。
We collaborate with leading industry experts.
我們與領先的產業專家合作。

items.colloc: locate a store 找到商店 | conveniently located 地點便利
items.distinct: find 發現 | situate 位於
ex: Our office is located near the station.
我們的辦公室位於車站附近。
Can you locate the missing file quickly?
你能快速找到遺失的檔案嗎？
The warehouse is conveniently located downtown.
倉庫地點位於市中心，十分便利。
